CweFindings.Name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
CweFindings.Description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
CweFindings.Explanation: User-assisted DOM XSS in the upload interface. PhotoServiceImpl.uploadPhoto preserves the multipart original filename, and HomeController.uploadPhotos returns it as originalFileName. upload.js createPhotoCard interpolates this value without escaping into HTML attributes and text at lines 185-189; displayNewPhotos inserts the result with insertAdjacentHTML at line 157. An administrator selecting or dropping an attacker-supplied image whose filename contains active HTML can cause JavaScript execution in the application origin with that administrator's browser privileges. showErrors also inserts filename-derived strings using innerHTML at lines 216-218. This is not demonstrated as persistent XSS affecting arbitrary gallery visitors: server-rendered Thymeleaf pages use escaping. Assessment severity MEDIUM, confidence 9/10. Browser execution was not verified because Playwright was unavailable.
